findings.evidence: <select id="dob-day-select" autocomplete="bday-day" required=""> <select id="dob-month-select" autocomplete="bday-month" required=""> <select id="dob-year-select" autocomplete="bday-year" required="">
findings.fix: Use three short text fields for day, month and year, with the numeric input mode.
findings.violation: A date the person knows by heart is picked from three drop-downs, the year from 60 options.

findings.evidence: #name-input (line 12) asks 'Full name'. #legalname-input (line 63) asks 'Your name' again. #website-input (line 37) asks 'Company website'. #contacttime-input (line 71) asks 'Preferred contact time'.
findings.fix: Remove the duplicate 'Your name' field. Remove 'Company website' unless this is specifically for business accounts. Move 'Preferred contact time' to a follow-up survey after account creation.
findings.violation: The form asks for the person's full name twice under different labels, and requests additional fields like company website and preferred contact time that are not necessary to create an account.

findings.evidence: <input id="postal-input" name="postal_code" type="text" autocomplete="postal-code" required="" size="3"> (size=3)
findings.fix: Size the field to show at least 5 characters.
findings.violation: This postal code field shows 3 characters, too few to show a typical value whole while it is typed and checked.

findings.fix: Loosen the pattern to accept every valid way of writing the value, and normalise it after submission.
findings.violation: The pattern on this phone field rejects valid values such as +44 20 7946 0958; 020 7946 0958.

findings.evidence: The 'View details' button (line 73) is positioned in the middle of the form, before the date-of-birth fieldset. The submit button (line 189) is at the end.
findings.fix: Move the secondary action to the end of the form, after all fields, in line with the primary action.
findings.violation: A secondary action is placed in the middle of the form, above the final fields, away from where the fields end and where the primary submit button sits.

findings.evidence: font-size: 13px declared by its inline style
findings.fix: Set the field's font size to at least 16 pixels.
findings.violation: The text in this field is 13 pixels, below the 16 pixels at which a phone stops zooming the page on focus.
This web address field is type text, so a phone does not show the keyboard built for it.

findings.evidence: #contacttime-label (line 70) has inline style="display:inline-block;float:left;width:140px", positioning it beside the input. Other labels use default positioning above their fields.
findings.fix: Remove the float:left and width styling from the #contacttime-label. Position it above its field to match the other labels.
findings.violation: The form mixes label positions: most labels sit above their fields, but the 'Preferred contact time' label is floated left and sits beside its field, creating visual inconsistency.

findings.evidence: #viewdetails-btn has style="padding:12px 20px;font-size:16px". With 12px vertical padding and approximately 20px text height, the total is roughly 32-36px, below the 44-48px mobile recommendation.
findings.fix: Increase padding to at least 8-10px above and below, or increase button height to 44-48px total.
findings.violation: The 'View details' button is approximately 32-36 pixels tall, below the 44-48 pixel size recommended for mobile touch targets.
